LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Writing
Topic 3.1: Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing, part of Writing in Grade 9 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can we enhance handwriting in Chinese?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to an audio recording of formal Chinese greetings and write them down (您 好、早上好、下午好、晚上好、老师 好、幸会) ,

2. match pictures with descriptions on the introduction of self and others (name, age, origin, place of residence, nationality, and language spoken),

3. work jointly to write sentences using 来 自...... (e.g. 我来自肯尼亚的西部),

4. introduce themselves and their friends in writing, giving their name, age, origin, place of residence, nationality, and language spoken ( e.g. 您好/早上好/下午好/晚上好/ 老师好,我朋友叫......,来自肯尼亚的西 部, 她住在......,她今年......岁,她会说 英语。很高兴认识您/幸会!),

5. make a scrap book of one’s best friend and share with peers for feedback,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to an audio recording of formal Chinese greetings and write them down (您 好、早上好、下午好、晚上好、老师 好、幸会) ,
2. match pictures with descriptions on the introduction of self and others (name, age, origin, place of residence, nationality, and language spoken),
3. work jointly to write sentences using 来 自...... (e.g. 我来自肯尼亚的西部),
4. introduce themselves and their friends in writing, giving their name, age, origin, place of residence, nationality, and language spoken ( e.g. 您好/早上好/下午好/晚上好/ 老师好,我朋友叫......,来自肯尼亚的西 部, 她住在......,她今年......岁,她会说 英语。很高兴认识您/幸会!),
5. make a scrap book of one’s best friend and share with peers for feedback,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: the learner writes fluently and in an organised manner short essays introducing self and

their friends.

• Creativity and Imagination: the learner undertakes tasks that allow the use of imagination when they create scrapbooks of

their best friends.

Values:
Respect: the learner shows positive regard for others by using formal and polite language to greet and introduce themselves.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Effective Communication: the learner employs the use of clear and legible handwriting to introduce themselves and others with

confidence.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the skills used in the artistic expression of ideas to Creative Arts and Sports.
